shorts.hook: Your pretzel is dipped in drain-cleaner chemistry
shorts.spoken: Here's something odd about every German pretzel.

shorts.hook: Three stories say who invented the pretzel
shorts.spoken: Who invented the lye pretzel? Three famous stories, three suspects.

shorts.hook: The real pretzel surprise: the baking tray
shorts.spoken: Old pretzel trays were aluminium, and lye eats aluminium. Germany measured: up to eighty-three milligrams per kilo of pastry.
